title: RefundRequested v1
description: Booking asks Payment to give the money of one payment back in full (ADR-0006, rules R4 and R7): the payment succeeded but the booking is expired or cancelled, or its seats are gone, or the customer cancelled a confirmed booking. Routing key: booking.refund-requested. Payment's queue: payment.booking.refund-requested. Asking twice is harmless: Payment refunds once per payment and a repeat changes nothing. There is no amount: the MVP refunds in full. It carries identifiers and a reason code only. Consumers ignore unknown fields (ADR-0009, part F).

eventId.description: ID of this message, used by consumers to recognize duplicates

occurredAt.description: When Booking decided that the money goes back

correlationId.description: The correlation ID of the request that caused the message, or null when no request did (a timer, a consumer)

aggregateId.description: The booking; the same as data.bookingId

paymentId.description: The payment to refund, from PaymentSucceeded

bookingId.description: The booking the payment was for; Payment checks that it is the payment's booking
